elements.requirement: For the purpose of calculating an award of compensation under section 63J(1)(b), an award of compensation under section 80I(1)(b), a basic award of compensation for unfair dismissal, an additional award of compensation for unfair dismissal, an award under section 112(5), or a redundancy payment, the amount of a week’s pay must not exceed £538.
